create_RGB_dataset_generator: create a RandomImageGenerator to sample RGB, depth, and semantic images from Habitat simulator scenes
build_Habitat_config: build a Habitat simulator config with RGB, depth, and semantic sensors for point navigation tasks
sample_RGB_depth_views: sample multiple RGB and depth views with randomized camera positions and rotations from a Habitat environment
load_vector_datasets: load and split PointNav datasets across multiple parallel Habitat vector environments for training
extract_semantic_annotations: extract class-level semantic segmentation labels from instance-level Habitat simulator semantic annotations
